evaluations.reasoning: Senior backend engineer with 6 years experience. Strong Python and Go skills, extensive experience with REST APIs, microservices, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes. Excellent match for all required and preferred qualifications.
Backend developer with 4 years experience. Strong Java and Python skills, experience with REST APIs, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Docker, AWS. Meets required qualifications well.
Backend engineer with 5 years experience specializing in Go. Strong experience with REST APIs, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, microservices. Excellent technical fit.
Frontend engineer with React/TypeScript focus. Has some backend exposure (Node.js, REST APIs) but primarily frontend experience. Could potentially transition but not ideal match.
DevOps engineer with strong infrastructure skills. Has Python scripting and understands backend systems but focuses on operations rather than application development. Related but different role.

Data engineer with Python and SQL experience. Has built backend APIs and understands databases but specializes in data pipelines rather than application backends. Transferable skills but different focus.
CPA with accounting and finance background. No software development experience. Skills in financial software (QuickBooks, SAP) are user-level, not development. Completely different field.
Registered nurse with healthcare experience. No technical or software development background. Technology experience limited to using EMR systems as end user. Unrelated field.
High school mathematics teacher. No software development experience. Technology skills limited to educational tools. Teaching experience not transferable to software engineering.
Marketing manager with digital marketing focus. No software development skills. Technology experience is with marketing tools and analytics platforms, not programming. Different career path.
